identity.title: No nitrogen fractionation on 600 au scale in the Sun progenitor analogue OMC-2 FIR4
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

evidence.quote: so that it cannot be excluded the presence of local spots enriched (or depleted) in $^{15}$N.

claims.hypothesis: Does 14N/15N vary between cores in OMC-2 FIR4 and differ from the single-dish value?
claims.experiment: Ratio of hyperfine peak fluxes of N2H+ to 15NNH+ and N15NH+ in five regions, compared with IRAM-30m
claims.result: R is ~200-370 in all regions within large errors and consistent with single-dish values
claims.finding: 14N/15N does not change from core to core nor from single-dish to interferometric scales

evidence.quote: We have derived that the $^{14}$N/$^{15}$N ratio does not vary from core to core, and our interferometric measurements are also consistent with single-dish observations.

claims.hypothesis: Do the two 15N-bearing isotopologues give different R?
claims.experiment: R computed separately from 15NNH+ and N15NH+ in each region
claims.result: Largest discrepancy in FIR4-east (360+/-140 vs 200+/-70), still consistent within errors
claims.finding: no significant difference between the two isotopologues

evidence.quote: We also do not find significant differences between the $^{14}$N/$^{15}$N ratios computed from the two $^{15}$N-bearing isotopologues

claims.hypothesis: Does N fractionation depend on temperature, as traced by D/H?
claims.experiment: D/H from N2D+ and N2H+ column densities compared with R in each region
claims.result: D/H ranges from 2.6e-3 (FIR4-east) to 1.4e-2 (FIR4-north) while R stays constant
claims.finding: 14N/15N does not depend on temperature variations (no N-H fractionation correlation)

evidence.quote: The D/H ratio derived by comparing the column densities of N$_{2}$D$^{+}$ and N$_{2}$H$^{+}$ changes by an order of magnitude from core to core, decreasing from the colder to the warmer cores.

claims.hypothesis: Is the 15N enrichment seen in Solar System objects inherited from the protocluster stage?
claims.experiment: Compare R across OMC-2 FIR4 cores with pristine Solar System values and pre-stellar cores
claims.result: R constant at core scales (~600 au), but only a lower limit R>=100-150 in the envelope
claims.finding: variations are likely not inherited from the protocluster stage; an envelope-to-core change cannot be ruled out

evidence.quote: Our findings also suggest that the $^{14}$N/$^{15}$N variations found in pristine Solar System objects are likely not inherited from the protocluster stage
from the envelope to the inner part of the protocluster as found in IRAS 05358+3543 cannot be ruled out

why_this_data.value: Single-dish measurements average over ~10000 au, so local 15N enriched or depleted spots could be hidden; ALMA gives ~600 au resolution.

evidence.quote: so that it cannot be excluded the presence of local spots enriched (or depleted) in $^{15}$N.

why_this_method.value: Peak flux ratio of isolated hyperfine components is equivalent to the total-flux ratio when optically thin with equal widths; D/H needed column densities because of different quantum numbers.

evidence.quote: then the ratio between the peak flux densities of these components is equivalent to the ratios between the total flux densities of the lines.
Due to the different quantum numbers of these transitions

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: N2H+ was fitted with three Tex assumptions (free, 35 K, 45 K) to test hyperfine anomalies and opacity effects

evidence.quote: we have performed a more accurate analysis of the line profile assuming three different $T_{\rm ex}$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Two alternative scenarios for the 15N enrichment: at the protoplanetary disk stage, or at different stages depending on the molecule

evidence.quote: we propose hence two alternative scenarios for the $^{15}$N enrichment

limitations_admitted.value: Uncertainties on opacities are underestimated when Tex is fixed in MADCUBA

evidence.quote: we stress that in some cases the uncertainties on the opacities are underestimated

limitations_admitted.value: A change of R from envelope to protocluster cannot be excluded; envelope limit R>=100-150 is not stringent

evidence.quote: hence not sufficient to put stringent constraints

limitations_admitted.value: Residual feature in N2D+ possibly from CH3CHO contamination; extra feature in some N15NH+ spectra at ~9 km/s

evidence.quote: This could be due to a contamination from the transition

referee_caveats_inferred: R uncertainties are large (20-40%), so the claim of no variation is weakly constraining
Regions were hand-drawn and overlap (FIR4-tot is a union of other regions), so values are not independent
Low S/N for 15NNH+ in FIR4-east (~4.2) and single-line peak-flux ratio ignores hyperfine anomalies beyond a rough estimate
D/H spans a factor ~5 yet the abstract calls it an order of magnitude
